segments.title: Lethal Company Co-Op Session
segments.notes: Anchor Case Blackwell hosts an extended Lethal Company gameplay session with in-studio contributor Kendelle and rotating remote players including Foxy Grandpa, Exterminator, Fancy, Rad, Nathan, and Christian; crew cycles through multiple moons, struggles with turret-heavy facilities, coil-head encounters, and bee-hive distractions, ultimately failing to reach premium moons before sign-off.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors a marathon Lethal Company co-op session, manages lobby mods and invitations, and coordinates crew survival across multiple quota runs.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Wakes up at 9 p.m. to join the Lethal Company session in person, provides live comms and item runs, and shares banter about sleep schedule and streaming setup.

lore_notes.fact: Mentions being rejected for a job at Autodesk but invited to their talent community [01:54:40].
Reports waking up at 9 p.m. and adjusting to night-time lighting setup [15:48].
Maintains three separate Lethal Company save files [48:27].

episode_summary: Barely Informed News anchor Case Blackwell departs the news desk for a four-hour Lethal Company co-op marathon, joined by in-studio contributor Kendelle and a rotating crew of remote players. The team cycles through turret-ridden facilities, coil-head gauntlets, and ill-timed bee-hive raids, repeatedly losing gear and crew to environmental hazards while failing to accumulate enough credits for premium moons. The broadcast concludes with a raid to a fellow Lethal Company streamer as Case signs off past his bedtime.
